question: With which of the following literary magazines was poet and writer Amrita Pritam associated?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Nagmani.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Amrita is considered a path-breaking woman, who rose to fame with her literary works like Pinjar, Suneray, and Nagmani.**
 
• **Amrita Pritam:**
 
 
• A renowned poetess, Amrita was born on** 31 August 1919 in Gujranwala, Punjab of British India, which now fall in Pakistan.**
 
• **She was the winner of the 17th Jnanpith Award.**
 
• Google doodle honoured Punjabi poetess Amrita Pritam with a doodle, marking her** 100th birthday.**
 
• She is considered to be the first poetess of the Punjabi language and is equally loved in both India and Pakistan.
 
• In her career of** 6 decades, she has written around 100 books**, including her famous autobiography** "Rasidi Ticket":**
 
 
• This book is an album of postage stamps.
 
• With each stamp, a new story unfolds on its postcard.
 
• The story doesn't have a closure which compels the reader to read the next chapter.
 
• In this book, she has written about her various phases of life.
 
 
 
• As a novelist her most important work was** Pinjar in 1950** whose background was the violence that happened against women and this novel made its way to an** award-winning film called Pinjar in 2003.**
 
• She was awarded** Padma Shri in 1969 **and** Padma Vibhushan and Sahitya Academy Award in 2004.**
